    def intent_residual(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        # Occurrence ranks preserve repetitions and support padding anywhere.
        valid = seq.ne(0)
        ranks = valid.long().cumsum(dim=1)
        length = seq.shape[1]
        positions = torch.arange(length, device=seq.device)
        causal = positions[None, :] <= positions[:, None]
        distance = ranks.unsqueeze(2) - ranks.unsqueeze(1)
        allowed = causal.unsqueeze(0) & valid.unsqueeze(1) & valid.unsqueeze(2)
        recent_mask = allowed & (distance >= 0) & (distance < self.recent_window)
        older_mask = allowed & (distance >= self.recent_window)

        embeddings = self.item_emb(seq)
        recent_weights = recent_mask.to(embeddings.dtype)
        recent_weights = recent_weights / recent_weights.sum(
            dim=-1, keepdim=True
        ).clamp_min(1)
        recent = torch.bmm(recent_weights, embeddings)

        has_older = older_mask.any(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        logits = torch.bmm(recent, embeddings.transpose(1, 2)) / math.sqrt(
            self.hidden_units
        )
        logits = logits.masked_fill(~older_mask, float("-inf"))
        # Empty older histories never enter an all-masked softmax.
        logits = torch.where(has_older, logits, torch.zeros_like(logits))
        weights = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1) * older_mask.to(embeddings.dtype)
        older = torch.bmm(weights, embeddings)
        gate = torch.sigmoid(self.intent_gate(torch.cat((recent, older), dim=-1)))
        gate = torch.where(has_older, gate, torch.ones_like(gate))
        residual = gate * self.recent_projection(recent)
        residual = residual + (1.0 - gate) * self.older_projection(older)
        return residual * valid.unsqueeze(-1).to(residual.dtype)

    def recent_mean(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        # Compress occurrence indices, preserving repeated IDs and internal padding.
        batch, length = seq.shape
        valid = seq.ne(0)
        ranks = valid.long().cumsum(dim=1)
        occurrence_ids = seq.new_zeros((batch, length + 1))
        occurrence_ids.scatter_add_(1, ranks, seq)
        k = min(self.recent_window, length)
        offsets = torch.arange(k, device=seq.device)
        recent_ranks = ranks.unsqueeze(-1) - offsets
        mask = recent_ranks.gt(0) & valid.unsqueeze(-1)
        recent_ids = occurrence_ids.gather(
            1, recent_ranks.clamp_min(0).reshape(batch, -1)
        ).reshape(batch, length, k)
        embeddings = self.item_emb(recent_ids).float()
        pooled = (embeddings * mask.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=2)
        count = mask.sum(dim=2, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1)
        return pooled / count

    def intent_residual(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        pooled = self.recent_mean(seq)
        scale = (pooled.square().mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
                 + self.normalization_eps).sqrt()
        return pooled / scale
